entry.title: Middle East Escalation Could Leave 11.7 Million More Women and Girls Facing Food Insecurity by End-2026
entry.summary:
GENEVA, October 13 (IPS) - An additional 11.7 million women and girls could face food insecurity by the end of 2026, as the escalation in the Middle East and disruption to the Strait of Hormuz drive up food prices and strain livelihoods and household resources, according to a new UN Women analysis published today.

entry.title: Dollar System Eroding Slowly, but Still Dominant
entry.summary:
KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia, October 13 (IPS) - The protracted demise of dollar-gold convertibility and associated fixed exchange rates did not end dollar hegemony. With crucial and timely help from political allies, confidence in the dollar system has persisted, albeit much diminished.

entry.summary:

entry.summary:
